name: Station 4, the Plains of Runners (PLAN.md section 9): N1 at 5.1 px 1616,539 (legacy 1344,209), BSk 3.5 km, 282 mm; the steppe colonies' cracked mosaic (needle fur, grey cushions, sac brush, ember hedges on the seams), inselbergs and tors (KSTACKS), a salt pan with its brine (the salt colonies), two washes, a herders' camp as records, carrion with its bone bloom
